recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for 4, 5, 6, 6X; add supplement trains or move work windows off 02:00-03:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Increase platform staffing / EMS coordination at Grand Central-42 St during 02:00-03:00
recommendations.rationale: Sick-customer and police holds are shortened by fast on-site response.

recommendations.action: Prioritise infrastructure & equipment work orders on the 4, 5, 6, 6X corridor near Grand Central-42 St

recommendations.action: Set a gap-filling rule: dispatch the next available train from Brooklyn Bridge-City Hall when a gap over 32 min forms
recommendations.rationale: A fifth of arrivals follow a large gap.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the longest waits, which dominate the APT metric.

recommendations.action: Expect sporadic holds; allow 5 extra minutes during 02:00-03:00
